title: OCSF Trace Profile
description: The Trace profile adds trace correlation fields to OCSF events per the OCSF 1.8 specification.

trace.description: The trace object carries the W3C trace context.

uid.description: The W3C trace ID (32 lowercase hex characters).

span.description: The span object (optional, not populated in this version).

id.description: The W3C span ID (16 lowercase hex characters).

start_time.description: The span start time in RFC3339 format.

end_time.description: The span end time in RFC3339 format.

profiles.description: List of OCSF profiles this event conforms to.
